details: IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva stated at the Jackson Hole symposium that while stablecoins and tokenization can reduce cross-border payment costs, they pose significant risks. These risks include intensifying currency substitution, creating capital flow pressures, and potentially weakening monetary sovereignty in emerging markets. Georgieva stressed the need for global regulatory coordination to manage these challenges.
title: IMF Warns Stablecoins Threaten Emerging Market Monetary Sovereignty

details: The European Central Bank (ECB) is set to launch its "Pontes" project in September 2026. This initiative aims to connect blockchain platforms to TARGET Services, enabling the settlement of transactions in central-bank money. ECB Executive Board member Isabel Schnabel highlighted the importance of central banks adopting blockchain technology to preserve their role in the financial system and counter the dominance of dollar stablecoins.
title: ECB to Launch Blockchain-Based Euro Settlement System Next Month

details: US Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh delivered a hawkish speech at the Jackson Hole symposium, indicating that the Fed might need to raise interest rates further if inflation does not ease to its 2% target. This hawkish stance contributed to a dip in Bitcoin's price and prompted net outflows from US spot Bitcoin ETFs, ending a nine-session inflow streak.
title: Hawkish Fed Commentary at Jackson Hole Pressures Bitcoin and Risk Assets

details: MicroStrategy, a prominent corporate holder of Bitcoin, announced it purchased 4,603 Bitcoins for approximately $397.7 million between August 24 and August 30, 2026. This marks a resumption of their Bitcoin acquisition strategy after a several-week hiatus, with an average purchase price of about $80,318 per Bitcoin.
title: MicroStrategy Resumes Significant Bitcoin Purchases

details: Bitcoin has consolidated around the $78,000 level after recently hitting a three-month high of $81,500. Analysis shows that large holders are actively accumulating Bitcoin, while smaller wallets are selling, suggesting a shift towards institutional interest. Furthermore, Bitcoin's 90-day correlation with gold has risen above 50%, indicating a growing perception of Bitcoin as a limited-supply asset amidst ongoing concerns about US debt.
title: Bitcoin Consolidates Near $78K, Institutional Accumulation Continues
